title: Further Account of Baba Banda Singh

blocks.text: Banda prepares an ambush in silence, restrains the right people, and waits until the raiders are fully inside before ordering the Singhs to strike.
When the blow falls, the attackers cannot master the field, and villagers begin interpreting the outcome through Banda’s “barkat,” seeing divine favor where they expected only violence.
After the raid is broken, captives are freed and selected goods are taken under discipline rather than chaos, turning the encounter into both punishment and demonstration.
